Fixes from Mac testing.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.6.4-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.6.4-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.6.4-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.6.4-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- The number next to Library counts the files in the library; "Remove finished" in the queue no longer resets it
- Mac: moving the window by the top strip no longer starts a text selection that could end up in the link field
- The start-up switch is named after the system: "Open at login" on Mac, "Start at login" on Linux

Thanks to Esquire_Gamer for testing on Mac.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.3...v2.6.4
